name: Do you offer free estimates for plumbing services?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer free estimates for plumbing services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alpha-Plumbing Services offers initial consultations to understand your plumbing needs. For specific repairs or installations, our technicians will assess the situation on-site and provide a detailed estimate before any work begins. While some initial assessments may involve a diagnostic fee, this fee is typically applied towards the total cost of the repair if you proceed with our services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alpha-Plumbing Services provides detailed estimates after an on-site assessment; a diagnostic fee may apply, often credited to the repair.
